name: runtrim-vscode
description: Local-first guarded run control surface for RunTrim in VS Code and Cursor.

runtrim.cli.path.description: Full path to the runtrim CLI executable (e.g. C:\Users\you\AppData\Roaming\npm\runtrim.cmd). Leave blank to auto-detect from PATH.

runtrim.agent.defaultAgent.description: Default selected agent for the RunTrim Agent Launcher.

runtrim.agent.customCommand.description: Custom local command template. Variables: {task}, {handoff}, {handoffPath}, {projectRoot}. Example: myagent {handoffPath}

runtrim.agent.claudeCommand.description: Claude Code local command template. Variables: {task}, {handoff}, {handoffPath}, {projectRoot}. Example: claude {handoffPath}

runtrim.agent.codexCommand.description: Codex local command template. Variables: {task}, {handoff}, {handoffPath}, {projectRoot}. Example: codex {handoffPath}

runtrim.agent.autoLaunchTerminal.description: When true, launch configured agent commands in a local VS Code terminal.
